tiled._recalibration_note: Re-derived via tools/derive_confidence_bounds.py after backend/app/layout.py's panel_sequence cx_frac fix (see git history) and a fresh tools/cache_ours_dumps.py-equivalent re-dump of all 4 boards' regenerated .cdr files. This cluster-level (metrics.geometric_accuracy) position error is HIGHER than before the fix (427mm -> 645mm), even though a direct, independently-verified measurement of each named group's own horizontal centroid (tamil_card/roof_graphic/enlarged_badge_card) showed a 78-96% REDUCTION in position error after the same fix. Both are real, reproducible measurements of the same 4 regenerated boards - not a computation error (confirmed: an untouched, unaffected untiled board reproduced its historical 0.976 visual score exactly, ruling out a general pipeline/measurement bug). The likely explanation is a known property of pixel-alignment metrics (SSIM in particular, which cluster/visual scoring depends on): a large positional error can place two hard-edged shapes in DISJOINT regions (background-vs-background compares as locally consistent almost everywhere), while a much smaller residual error can leave them PARTIALLY OVERLAPPING - direct edge-vs-edge pixel conflict, which these metrics penalize far more harshly than two cleanly-separated wrong regions, even though the true positional accuracy improved. This value is intentionally kept at the higher (more conservative/safer) figure rather than substituting the centroid-based number, since it is the same methodology already used for every other regime in this file and errs toward caution, not toward making the fix look better. Recommended follow-up: investigate whether metrics.geometric_accuracy's clustering (bbox-proximity, independent of the named panel_sequence groups) should be made partial-overlap-aware, or whether a centroid-distance-based check should be added alongside it.

untiled._caveat: position/size errors exclude the 'shopname' role - validate_all.py's greedy nearest-centre matcher can cross-pair Agarpathi's two separate shopname text objects (Tamil + English, at very different page positions), confirmed on the master-regenerated-as-itself sanity check (every other of 29 matched objects differed by 0.0mm, but shopname alone showed a ~1600mm 'error' equal to the real distance between the two text boxes - a matching artifact, not a placement error). This is a tooling gap in validate_all.py, not fixed here; shopname accuracy itself is unmeasured by these bounds and content_check.py's exact-text check remains the only verified signal for it. Even excluding shopname, error here is large (median ~380mm) - the generic per-object scale+centre engine does not reproduce Agarpathi's real hand-placed logo positions well across this landscape sample, unlike dalmia's much smaller untiled median (~116-139mm).
